pages.text: $(item)Slime Rod$() — all sticky and gooey~ A successful use $(#FF69B4)clears Estrus$(), and there's a $(#FF69B4)1/500$() chance a tiny slime owned by the target spawns! (๑>ᴗ<๑)

$(item)Giant Rod$() — «This might be too big to insert safely...»$(br2)In fact nobody can take it... except the $(#FF69B4)Ender Dragon$(). Using it on a dragon causes climax and makes it drop a $(item)Dragon Egg$()!
$(item)Cactus Rod$() — do NOT try this in real life!!!$(br2)Deals $(#FF69B4)10 points$() of cactus damage to the user. Pain and pleasure (not really).
$(item)Edible Rod$() — slightly sour, slightly salty after use...$(br2)Eat it and you'll be teleported somewhere nearby (the price of taste). $(#FF69B4)Your own one? Not recommended, meow.$()
